notes.notes: [p][b]◈ September 25 Maintenance Patch Notes[/b][/p][p][b] [/b][/p][p][b]● Maintenance Time : 9:00 ~ 13:30 (KST)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]​[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/4d48646ca80360d93bfecc2cd6de113dd04d19a8.png"][/img][/p][p]◆ New Weapon: Orbina[/p][p]ㆍRarity: EX[/p][p]ㆍType: Staff[/p][p]ㆍATK Type: Magic ATK[/p][p] [/p][p]ㆍUnique Effects[/p][p]① \[Blessing of the Earth][/p][p] [/p][p]Increases Magic ATK by N% during combat.[/p][p] [/p][p]When using any skill except Standby, gain the \[Blessing of the Architect] effect for NR.[/p][p] [/p][p]\[Blessing of the Architect]: Increases Heat Boost by N%. Stacks up to N times.[/p][p] [/p][p]② \[Prisoner Signature: Harmony of the Architect][/p][p] [/p][p]At the start of combat, for N times only, the AP cost of “Summon Lava” is reduced to 0, and its cooldown is reduced by NR.[/p][p] [/p][p]At the start of combat, gain a shield equal to N% of base Magic ATK for NR. The shield is removed at the end of any turn in which you take damage.[/p][p] [/p][p]Increases Magic ATK and Heat Boost by N% during combat. The attack radius of “Summon Lava” and its \[Lava] zone increases by Nm.[/p][p] [/p][p]Reduces the AP cost of “Volcanic Eruption” by N during combat, and increases the DMG of “Forbidden Land” by N%.[/p][p] [/p][p]If HP is at N%, reduces the AP cost of “Summon Energy” by N%.[/p][p]▶ Prisoner’s DMG Structure – Issues Identified[/p][p] [/p][p]Requires Warm-Up: To deal stable damage early in battle, multiple casts of “Summon Lava” are necessary.[/p][p] [/p][p]Reduced Damage Due to AoE Utility: While Prisoner benefits from the convenience of wide-area attacks, her damage output was comparatively low. Even when meeting max damage conditions, her firepower fell short compared to other units of similar cost.[/p][p] [/p][p]▶ Signature Weapon “Orbina” – Key Features[/p][p] [/p][p]Immediate Lava Setup: At the start of combat, “Summon Lava” can be instantly deployed up to its maximum count, removing the need for warm-up.[/p][p] [/p][p]Enhanced Forbidden Land: Greatly increased damage allows this skill to remain competitive in the current meta.[/p][p] [/p][p]Early Heat Boost: A powerful Heat Boost effect is granted immediately at the start of combat, ensuring strong firepower from the very beginning.[/p][p] [/p][p]▶ Expected Results[/p][p]Prisoner previously struggled due to strict conditions and low efficiency relative to her high cost. With her signature weapon “Orbina,” however:[/p][p] [/p][p]A stable damage-dealing environment can be established immediately from the start.[/p][p] [/p][p]She can repeatedly trigger the empowered Forbidden Land while being shielded by allies.[/p][p] [/p][p]She can finally perform at a level befitting her 8-cost status.[/p][p][/p][p]​[/p][p][/p][p]◆ New Costumes[/p][p]​​[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/57f22065ce354501654ff4adb86d275a8ed4b6ac.png"][/img][/p][p]▶ Prisoner – Cozy Knit Love[/p][p]ㆍNew Vanguard costume “Cozy Love Knit” for Prisoner has been added.[/p][p]ㆍObtainable through the Liberated Prisoner Pass.[/p][p]After the Season Pass ends, limited-time costumes will be available in the Shop.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/55bdda174c0be1d1b915eab66f4ebb37a1c0c16c.png"][/img][/p][p]▶ Fammene – Golden Temptation Bunny Girl[/p][p]ㆍNew Vanguard costume “Golden Temptation Bunny Girl” for Fammene has been added.[/p][p]ㆍObtainable through the Golden Temptation Bunny Girl Attendance Event.[/p][p]This costume is only available through this attendance event.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Special Search Updates[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/1be32537aaaf260160430c900ebda6f973d5f13e.png"][/img][/p][p]ㆍThe following banners will end: The Sweetly Savage Coward/ Red Pudding / Soft & Feature[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/e6498931126bdf6be52c56b7a2570f62e0bf45ab.png"][/img][/p][p]Stigma UI has been revamped for improved convenience.[/p][p]ㄴ Stigma types are now visually distinct.[/p][p]ㄴ Stigma stats are categorized into three tiers: Low (Brown), Normal (Gray), and High (Yellow).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291709/ad5ee1b257195170307f39b90f6e47657d19f263.png"][/img][/p][p]Filter customization has been enhanced.[/p][p]ㄴ In addition to sorting, sub-stat categories, and set filters, players can now filter by stat tier (≥/≤), enhancement state, and stigma rank.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Improvements[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where characters affected by placed skills would continue receiving effects after leaving the range.[/p][p]- Added missing tooltip text: When Prisoner’s Forbidden Land activates during her turn, damage from Forbidden Land is applied twice.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where overlapping “Summon Lava” zones caused Forbidden Land DMG not to apply after one expired.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where “Forbidden Land” did not benefit from level-up effects.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ Bug Fixes[/p][p]- Fixed abnormal text display in Korabi’s Bath scene.[/p][p]- Fixed abnormal notifications appearing when clearing Rift floors above 28.[/p][p]- Fixed forced focus to floor 1 after clearing Rift 30.[/p]

During a Support Counter, Magic ATK increases by N% and Crit Rate increases by N% until the end of the turn.[/p][p]After a Support Counter, there is an N% chance to trigger an Additional Response. Frenzy]: Gain AP, increase AP Recovery, but decrease all ATK.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][tr][td colwidth="109"][p]Whirlwind of Bloodlust[/p][/td][td colwidth="63"][p]Active[/p][/td][td][p]- Gains stacks of [b]\[Bloodlust][/b] as battle progresses.[/p][p]- Activates when holding 5 or more stacks.[/p][p]- Deals [b]Slash DMG[/b] to enemies in an area and slightly pulls them toward the center.[/p][p]- Cannot trigger a Weak Point attack.[/p][p][i]\[Bloodlust]: Base effect of Whirlwind of Bloodlust. Stacks up to 5 times.[/i][/p][/td][/tr][/table][p][b]| New Character Introduction: Korabi[/b][/p][p]Korabi, the one who wields the power sealed within an ancient mask, joins as a new vanguard.[/p][p]She manipulates the power of blood through her mask, serving as a supporter to aid her allies.[/p][p]Normally quiet and hesitant, she occasionally erupts with sudden bursts of temper, unleashing devastating attacks. Still, she rarely takes the frontline herself, as her inherently timid nature holds her back.[/p][p][/p][p][b]| Combat Role[/b][/p][p]Ally Healing / Ally Enhancement / Enemy Disruption / Hit-Condition Synergy[/p][p]Korabi grants buffs based on critical damage to a single ally while forcing multiple enemies to act quickly but weakly. She shines best in parties that rely on effects triggered by taking hits.[/p][p][/p][p][b]| Combat Concept Details[/b][/p][p]Korabi supports her team by granting enemies more turns but reducing their attack power, allowing allies to safely and quickly trigger hit-based conditions.[/p][p]Her unique form of support ensures allies take less damage while taking hits faster.[/p][p]At the same time, she enhances the offensive power of specific allies, focusing the team’s firepower where it’s needed most.[/p][p][/p][p][b]| Character Traits[/b][/p][p]Though timid in nature, Korabi occasionally loses control of her emotions, leading her to act aggressively.[/p][p]When allies are attacked, there is a chance she unknowingly unleashes hidden power, striking back fiercely at the enemy.[/p][p]This can sometimes result in unexpected advantages—or mishaps. But a person’s nature isn’t easily changed. Perhaps you, Human God, can turn even Korabi’s quirks into strengths.[/p][p][/p][p][b]| Exclusive Weapon Features[/b][/p][p]Korabi’s exclusive weapon, Red Pudding, enhances her base stats, strengthens allies further, and boosts overall team survivability.[/p][p]It also makes previously impossible party compositions viable under certain conditions.[/p][p]Since the weapon boosts Slash Enhancement for allies, Korabi becomes a valuable choice not only for crit-focused dealers but also for those who rely more on Slash stats, adding diversity to team-building.[/p][p][/p][p][b]| Recommended Compositions[/b][/p][p]She pairs well with pure tanks, charging warriors, and counterattack/support-counter dealers that rely on hit conditions.[/p][p]Korabi stabilizes their damage output while maximizing the potential of hit-based mechanics.[/p][p][/p][p]Korabi is not merely a supporter who strengthens allies.[/p][p]The power of her mask makes her a strategic cornerstone for “grow stronger while being hit” compositions, adding new depth to the battlefield.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]◆ New Weapon: Red Pudding[/p][p]ㆍRarity: EX[/p][p]ㆍType: Staff[/p][p]ㆍATK Type: Magic ATK[/p][p][/p][p]▶ Unique Effects[/p][p]① \[Painborne Bloom][/p][p]-During combat, Magic ATK increases by N%.[/p][p]Enemies hit are afflicted with \[Pulse of the Rift] for NR.[/p][p]\[Pulse of the Rift]: Increases SPD by N% and decreases Physical DEF.[/p][p][/p][p]② \[Korabi Signature: Blooming Bloodlust][/p][p]-During combat, Additional Response triggered by the skill Timid, Yet Explosive! activates with N% chance.[/p][p]-The \[Burning Desire] effect granted by the skill Blood Pact increases the target ally’s Slash Boost and Crush Boost by N% of your Base Slash Boost, and increases their Melee ATK and Ranged ATK by N% of your Base Magic ATK.[/p][p](Slash Boost and Crush Boost gained this way cannot exceed N%.)[/p][p]-When using the skill Whirlwind of Bloodlust, removes Weak Points from all allies notes.title: 《Horizon Walker》Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello, Human God![/p][p]We’d like to inform you that a bundle patch was released on 8/29 (Fri).[/p][p]By updating the game, you will be able to download the bundle patch, which includes the following fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the graphic beautify function did not work under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some battle backgrounds were displayed as black.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where certain characters would appear black when receiving a stealth effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Default graphic options have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the image quality of certain UI elements was degraded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where character models could not be rotated in the shop and character status screen.[/p][/*][/list][p]Since this is a bundle patch, no separate maintenance will be conducted.[/p][p]Thank you![/p]
